content.short: KEVM is a model of the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) with K semantics.
content.description: KEVM provides a model of the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) implemented with the K framework. The model and its walkthrough help you write custom tests from a language and environment you deploy and maintain. Developers can craft tests with greater control over how the framework’s semantics are applied, enabling more precise test scenarios. A working knowledge of the K framework or its implementations is a prerequisite to effectively using KEVM. It emphasizes test customization and control.
